verdict.rationale: Mercury claims accounts reconcile automatically and continuously in real time, including linked external bank accounts, inside a double-entry ledger. However, nothing documents a per-account reconciliation workspace that shows matched, unmatched, or duplicate transactions for an accountant to review. Duplicate detection is documented only for bills in bill pay, not for bank-feed transactions. Mercury itself says the automation is a starting point, not autopilot. Missing for 10: per-account bank-to-ledger reconciliation view, surfacing of unmatched transactions for review, duplicate bank-transaction detection, statement-balance matching, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
